import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # noqa: E402
import pandas as pd  # noqa: E402

# Panel order requested by the user: precipitation, max temperature, min temperature.
PANEL_ORDER = ["PRCP", "TMAX", "TMIN"]
REQUIRED_COLS = {"date", "variable", "label", "units", "this_year", "ten_year_avg"}


def main(inputs, outputs, params):
    """Fan-in the per-variable summaries from process_weather_variable and plot a three-panel
    figure (PRCP, TMAX, TMIN): this year solid, 10-year average dashed."""
    # inputs["input1"] is a folder holding every per-variable summary
    # (weather_summary_<rank>.csv), and only those.
    folder = inputs["input1"]
    basenames = sorted(os.listdir(folder))
    if not basenames:
        msg = f"ERROR: the input folder {folder} holds no summary files"
        print(msg, flush=True)
        raise FileNotFoundError(msg)
    print(f"Found {len(basenames)} summary files: {basenames}", flush=True)

    frames = {}
    for name in basenames:
        df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(folder, name))
        missing = REQUIRED_COLS - set(df.columns)
        if df.empty or missing:
            msg = f"ERROR: {name} is empty or missing columns {sorted(missing)}"
            print(msg, flush=True)
            raise ValueError(msg)
        df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
        var = str(df["variable"].iloc[0])
        frames[var] = df

    absent = [v for v in PANEL_ORDER if v not in frames]
    if absent:
        msg = f"ERROR: missing summaries for variables {absent}; found {sorted(frames)}"
        print(msg, flush=True)
        raise ValueError(msg)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(11, 10), sharex=True)
    for ax, var in zip(axes, PANEL_ORDER):
        df = frames[var]
        label = str(df["label"].iloc[0])
        units = str(df["units"].iloc[0])
        ax.plot(df["date"], df["this_year"], linestyle="-", color="tab:blue",
                linewidth=1.6, label="2025")
        ax.plot(df["date"], df["ten_year_avg"], linestyle="--", color="tab:red",
                linewidth=1.6, label="10-year average (2015-2024)")
        ax.set_title(f"{label} ({var})")
        ax.set_ylabel(units)
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
        ax.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=9)
    axes[-1].set_xlabel("Date")
    fig.suptitle("Corvallis, OR (USC00351862): winter 2025 vs. previous 10-year daily average")
    fig.autofmt_xdate()
    fig.tight_layout()

    fig.savefig(outputs["output1"], dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f"Wrote three-panel figure to {outputs['output1']}", flush=True)
